# Quarterly Market Outlook — Q3

Equity markets ended the quarter mixed. Large caps gained 2.1% while small caps slipped 0.8%. Bond yields drifted lower as inflation data came in slightly below expectations.

## Sector performance

Energy and utilities led; consumer discretionary lagged. Our model portfolio remains overweight healthcare.
